items.title: Equinix & CPP Investments Complete $4 Billion atNorth Acquisition

items.title: Trump Warned Towns They’d End Up Poor Without Data Centers but Berkshire’s CEO Sees a Revolt Growing
items.summary: A White House AI adviser is selling data centers as economic lifelines while Berkshire's Greg Abel warns of a full-blown revolt taking shape in communities across the country. One of them is reading a very different map of where a trillion dollars in AI spending actually lands.

items.title: Digital Realty vs. Equinix: Which AI Dividend Scores Higher?
items.summary: Both data center REITs just paid shareholders, both ride the same AI wave, but their dividend scorecards look nothing alike. One has raised its payout for over a decade while the other has frozen shareholders out for four years despite surging earnings.
